answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 38584 Country: India Title: Before two months of my son's birth I saw a dream that a son has born to my wife and I went near my wife to see him Question: Before two months of my son's birth I saw a dream that a son has born to my wife and I went near my wife to see him. Then I hear a voice ISKA NAAM ABDUL REHMAN HAI I wake up. After two months on Friday my son born we put the name him ABDUL REHMAN. Should we remain the same name of my son or we have to change it? Answer ID: 38584 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 909/747/B=1433) Your dream came true. Its meaning is obvious. May the son and the name which you chose be blessed! This name is good. It is inspirational name. You must not change this name. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
